meta.parties: Lanka Estates Agency, Ltd. v. Corea

rules.statement: The coming into operation of the Rent Restriction Act after an action for ejectment has already commenced does not affect the landlord's accrued right to claim ejectment under common law.
rules.supporting_quote: "I would therefore hold that the coining into operation of the Act after an action for ejectment has already commenced does not affect the landlord's accrued right to claim ejectment in these proceedings."
